name: Tree Service
headline: Websites for tree service companies that get the call after the storm.
intro: When a tree comes down, people grab their phone and search. The tree service that shows up first, with a big call button and real photos, gets the job. We build that site.
build: An emergency page with a call button and "24/7" at the very top
A page for each service: removal, trimming, stump grinding, land clearing
An Areas We Serve section with the towns you work in
A quote form where customers upload a photo of the tree
A before and after gallery of your jobs

name: Roofing
headline: Websites for roofers that turn storm searches into inspections.
intro: A roof is a big decision, and homeowners check you out before they call. Your site has to look established, show your work and make booking an inspection easy.
build: A free inspection form that lands in your phone
Pages for repair, replacement, storm damage and insurance claims
An Areas We Serve section with the towns you work in
A project gallery and your Google reviews on the page
Financing information, if you offer it

name: HVAC
headline: Websites for HVAC companies that win the 'AC is out' search.
intro: Nobody shops for an HVAC company until something breaks. When it does, they want someone fast. Your site needs to show up first and make calling you take one tap.
build: A same-day service button on every page
Pages for AC repair, heating repair, installs and maintenance plans
An Areas We Serve section with the towns you work in
Online booking for tune-ups and maintenance visits
A sign-up page for maintenance plans that bill monthly

name: Plumbing
headline: Websites for plumbers that ring your phone, not your competitor's.
intro: A leak can't wait, and neither will your customer. If your site is slow or hard to use on a phone, they hit the back button and call the next plumber.
build: A click-to-call button at the top of every page
Pages for emergencies, drains, water heaters and repipes
An Areas We Serve section with the towns you work in
A quote form for bigger jobs like water heaters
Your licenses, insurance and reviews where people can see them

name: Salons and Barbers
headline: Websites for salons and barbershops that fill the chair.
intro: Instagram shows your work, but it doesn't show up on Google. A real site puts you in front of people searching for a new barber or stylist, and sends them straight to booking.
build: A Book Now button that goes to the booking app you already use
A page for each service with prices
Your Instagram work on the site
A page for each stylist or barber
Hours, location and parking info that Google can read

name: Wedding Vendors
headline: Websites for wedding vendors that book the date.
intro: Couples compare a dozen vendors before they reach out. DJs, photographers, florists and venues need a site that shows the work, answers questions and makes it easy to check a date.
build: A check-your-date form that sends you the couple's details
Packages and starting prices
A gallery or video of real weddings
Deposits by card to lock in the date
Reviews from couples on every page

name: Auto Repair & Performance
headline: Websites for auto repair and performance shops that book the job before the call.
intro: Car people search, compare prices and watch builds before they pick a shop. The shop with real prices, real build photos and a book button gets the car. We build that site.
build: Your packages and prices posted up front, with booking and a deposit online
Full pages for your best-paying work, like cam installs and tuning
A builds gallery that opens full screen, plus your YouTube videos
Smaller jobs like brakes and oil changes bookable in one tap
An Areas We Serve section with the towns you work in
